scoring.explanations: Per case: held misconceptions (MC-STOP-IMPLICIT, MC-BASE-SMALLEST) vs label → micro P/R/F1; C3 judgment exact match (met / not_met / unclear; partial counts as wrong). 'Rejects' findings are not held. Errors count as wrong with no misconception.
scoring.verifier: Outcome exact match (demonstrated / still_developing / insufficient_evidence) from sandbox tests + reading + verify-v1 rules.
scoring.diagnosis: Category exact match from sandbox + probes + reading + planning rules.
